bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
app="$root/.worktrees/profile-live-20261114"
echo "GSERVER_REPO_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "APP_WORKTREE_PRESENT=$(test -d "$app" && echo yes || echo no)"
if test -d "$app"; then
 echo "APP_HEAD=$(git -C "$app" rev-parse HEAD)"
 echo "APP_BRANCH=$(git -C "$app" branch --show-current)"
 echo "APP_DIRTY=$(test -z "$(git -C "$app" status --porcelain)" && echo no || echo yes)"
fi
echo "LIVE_IMAGE=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
echo "LIVE_RUNNING=$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
echo "LOCAL_TAG=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
echo "GAYBBS_BUNDLE_PR53_HEAD=f568489b4a04d51a70c77ace8b6bd4b011df0efe"
